title: Amethyst Golem Charm
description: The golem can collect gems from <keyword>amethyst</keyword>, <keyword>topaz</keyword>, and <keyword>citrine</keyword> geodes! Even better, it can turn blocks of these gems and turn them into their budding variants!
To make an Amethyst Golem, activate a Ritual of Awakening next to a Budding Amethyst Block.
You can kill the <keyword>golem</keyword> to get back the <keyword>charm</keyword>, which will easily resummon it.
Голем может собирать гемы из <keyword>аметистовых</keyword>, <keyword>топазовых</keyword> и <keyword>цитриновых</keyword> жеод!
